nameOrigin: the flat cutting part of a sword, etc.

pokedexEntries.x: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

pokedexEntries.or: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

pokedexEntries.y: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

pokedexEntries.as: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

pokedexEntries.sw: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

pokedexEntries.sh: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

pokedexEntries.za: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
